raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Bodyweight & Minimal Equipment Strength Program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Develop hypertrophy and maximal strength with bodyweight and minimal equipment in a 12-week progression"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Foundational Strength A":
        warmup:
          cardio jog 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Pushup progression 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Inverted_row progression 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat progression 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Hip_thrusts_on_floor 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Foundational Strength B":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes brisk walk
        main straight_sets:
          Doorway_pullup_bar_assisted_pullups 3x4..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Ring_row_progression 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Step_up_to_balancing 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Glute_bridge_on_floor 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
          quadriceps_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Foundational Strength C":
        warmup:
          mobility sequence 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Pushup_variation_ incline 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Doorway_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Split_squat_to_couch 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Abdomen_brace 3x12..20 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Progression A":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Pushup_variation_2 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Inverted_row_adjusted 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat_progress 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Hip_thrusts_floor_and_hold 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 60 seconds
          glute_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Progression B":
        warmup:
          mobility circuit 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Pullup_bar_assisted_variation 4x5..9 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Bodyweight_row_progress 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Sumo_step_up_paid 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          Plank_variation 4x20..40s rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Progression C":
        warmup:
          dynamic_activation 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Pushup_with_tempo 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Doorway_pullup_bar_negative 4x4..6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pistol_squat_assisted 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Superman_plate_hold 4x15..30s rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_release 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Strength Crest A":
        warmup:
          light_jog 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Pushup_vars_depth 5x5..9 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Pullup_bar_norm_pullups 5x4..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat_heavy 5x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Hip_thrusts_with_breath 5x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility_routine 5 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 65m "Strength Crest B":
        warmup:
          activation_routine 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Inverted_row_advanced 5x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Doorway_pullup_bar_chinups 5x4..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Step_up_to_couch_heavy 5x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Plank_to_pushup 5x10..20s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_release 60 seconds
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 65m "Strength Crest C":
        warmup:
          dynamic_stretch 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Pushup_to_failure 4x5..9 rpe 9 rest 105 seconds
          Ring_row_progression_heavy 4x6..10 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          Pistol_squat_to_box 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Glute_bridge_single_leg 4x10..14 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 5 minutes

Notes:
- All exercises use bodyweight and minimal equipment (mat and a doorway pull-up bar). If a true progression cannot be performed (e.g., no rings or floor sliders), substitute with a safe, equivalent bodyweight variation.
- Reps and sets follow the DSL: sets first (e.g., 3x8..12), RPE appended after reps (rpe <value>), rest specified in seconds.
- RPE targets are modest for weeks 1-4, increasing through weeks 9-12 to stimulate adaptation.
- Week structure: 4 weeks per phase, with a gradual increase in volume/complexity across phases.
- Ensure technique and full range of motion on all movements. If any movement causes pain, substitute or reduce intensity.
- Weekly progression: aim to add reps, improve form, or reduce rest slightly every 1-2 weeks within the same phase, staying within safe RPE targets.

END
